headline: Girlguiding redesigns uniform "to be styled any way the girls want"
context: British youth organisation Girlguiding has unveiled the first update to its formerly regimented uniform in 30 years, intended to allow more freedom of expression. Completed in collaboration with London studio Hemingway Design, the redesign includes 30 garments and 15 accessories

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: British youth organisation Girlguiding has unveiled the first update to its formerly regimented uniform in 30 years, intended to allow more freedom of expression. Completed in collaboration with London studio Hemingway Design, the redesign includes 30 garments and 15 accessories and neckerchiefs created for Girlguilding's four age groups known as Rainbows, Brownies, Guides and Rangers. The post Girlguiding redesigns uniform "to be styled any way the girls want" appeared first on Dezeen .
